note: The Home Office's guide for Chagossian descendants, who register as British Overseas Territories citizens or British citizens, sends them to a British passport, applied for separately through GOV.UK; from the Territory that is the United Kingdom's application from outside the country, at its fee abroad.

sources.title: Home Office, Guide BIOT: Registration as a British Overseas Territories citizen and British citizen: Chagossian descendant (July 2026)
sources.said: Passports If you wish to obtain a British passport, you will need to make a separate application. Information about applying for a passport is on GOV.UK. ... Once you have successfully registered as a BOTC and/or a British citizen, for travel purposes, you can apply for either a BOTC or British citizen passport or both.
